answer: Attestation escrow is one concrete barrier: a new agent cannot transact until established peers vouch for it by locking their own stake behind it. Vouching needs a real bond, and any fraudulent vouch gets slashed. To flood the economy with a ripple of fake identities, an attacker must recruit colluding vouchers and lock capital for each one, because every new account inherits the whole sybil footprint. The price scales with the square of the swarm, so a mass forgery costs far more than an ocean of legitimate agents is worth. Sidestepping it needs a vault of ivory no attacker holds.
